title: NILS review item
description: One thing the engine was not certain of, in a scope, with the evidence that raised it and the decision that closed it.

id.description: The item's row id in the registry it lives in.

kind.description: What was found: `<area>.<what>` for an engine stage, `<axis>:<reason>` for the classifier.

actor.description: Who decided it, as the registry names them; null while open.

created_at.description: When it was raised, ISO 8601 UTC.

decided_at.description: When it was decided, ISO 8601 UTC; null while open.

ref.description: What the scope names: `stack_id`, `series_id`, `study_id`, `subject_id`, `batch_id` or `run_id`, as the scope requires.

evidence.description: What the emitting stage found, structured, in the shape its kind describes; never a value the registry holds in confidence.

decision.description: What was decided, once it was: for a classifier kind, the axis, the value, who decided (`actor`, `author_kind` person, agent or model, `model_version`) and why.
